description: Source mode, external and missing references: an agent that uses an ARM resource in another resource group (external), an unknown name (missing), and a connection whose target is an external URL.
azureYaml:
name: external-references-sample
services:
  ai-project:
    host: azure.ai.project
  assistant:
    host: azure.ai.agent
    uses:
      - ai-project
      - shared-search
      - /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/rg-shared/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/stshared
  docs-conn:
    host: azure.ai.connection
    target: https://contoso.example.com/docs
